coverage.statement: EXHAUSTIVE at the whole-drive level. WizTree indexed the entire C: and D: MFT (12,677,705 rows streamed; corroborated within 4 rows of Codex's independent 12,677,701). The doc corpus was reduced to a harness/agentic candidate set by keyword+root filters, exclusions applied as FILTERS not scan boundaries, then clustered (377 clusters) and reconciled. Every doc in the union is classified at least at cluster level; the 46 largest clusters carry explicit per-cluster verdicts; the ~331 tail clusters (rows 46-376, each 1-7 docs) are rolled up by class.
